fields.label: Template Code
fields.description: Matches Tender Form Requirement.form_code (SBD1, MBD4, C1.1, POPIA...) - the regime's form list selects templates by this code

fields.label: Guide Reference
fields.description: Section of tender/SA-Tender-Completion-Guide.md this template is derived from

fields.label: Initial Every Page
fields.description: Pack checklists audit per-page initials on this form - a signed pack stamps the initials image in the page footer; an unsigned pack renders the reminder strip

fields.label: Completion Instructions
fields.description: Form-level guidance printed under the form header (derived from the guide's per-form kill notes)

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Ordered field list - each row auto-fills from the business profile or the bid, or renders as a clearly marked USER INPUT blank
